cards.back: 4 equal sides, 4 right angles, 4 lines of symmetry, opposite sides parallel.
cards.say: Properties of a square. four equal sides, four right angles, four lines of symmetry, opposite sides parallel.

cards.back: 4 right angles, opposite sides equal and parallel, 2 lines of symmetry.
cards.say: Properties of a rectangle. four right angles, opposite sides equal and parallel, two lines of symmetry.

cards.back: 4 equal sides, opposite sides parallel, opposite angles equal, 2 lines of symmetry.
cards.say: Properties of a rhombus. four equal sides, opposite sides parallel, opposite angles equal, two lines of symmetry.

cards.back: Opposite sides equal and parallel, opposite angles equal. No right angles needed.
cards.say: Properties of a parallelogram. Opposite sides equal and parallel, opposite angles equal. No right angles needed.

cards.back: Exactly one pair of parallel sides.
cards.say: Properties of a trapezium. Exactly one pair of parallel sides.

cards.back: Two pairs of equal sides next to each other. One line of symmetry.
cards.say: Properties of a kite. Two pairs of equal sides next to each other. One line of symmetry.

cards.front: How many sides: pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, decagon?
cards.say: How many sides: pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, decagon? five, six, seven, eight and ten.

cards.back: A polygon with all sides equal and all angles equal. Example: a square.
cards.say: What is a regular polygon? A polygon with all sides equal and all angles equal. Example: a square.

cards.back: The distance from the centre of a circle to its edge.
cards.say: Radius. The distance from the centre of a circle to its edge.

cards.back: A line across a circle through the centre. It is twice the radius.
cards.say: Diameter. A line across a circle through the centre. It is twice the radius.

cards.back: The distance around the outside of a circle.
cards.say: Circumference. The distance around the outside of a circle.

cards.front: A circle has radius 6 cm. What is its diameter?
cards.back: 12 cm. Diameter = 2 × radius.
cards.say: A circle has radius six centimetres. What is its diameter? twelve centimetres. Diameter equals two times radius.

cards.front: A circle has diameter 9 cm. What is its radius?
cards.back: 4.5 cm. Radius = diameter ÷ 2.
cards.say: A circle has diameter nine centimetres. What is its radius? four point five centimetres. Radius equals diameter divided by two.

cards.front: Faces, edges and vertices of a cube
cards.back: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices.
cards.say: Faces, edges and vertices of a cube. six faces, twelve edges, eight vertices.

cards.front: Faces, edges and vertices of a cuboid
cards.back: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices.
cards.say: Faces, edges and vertices of a cuboid. six faces, twelve edges, eight vertices.

cards.front: Faces, edges and vertices of a triangular prism
cards.back: 5 faces, 9 edges, 6 vertices.
cards.say: Faces, edges and vertices of a triangular prism. five faces, nine edges, six vertices.

cards.front: Faces, edges and vertices of a square-based pyramid
cards.back: 5 faces, 8 edges, 5 vertices.
cards.say: Faces, edges and vertices of a square based pyramid. five faces, eight edges, five vertices.

cards.back: 2 flat circular faces and 1 curved surface.
cards.say: Faces of a cylinder. two flat circular faces and one curved surface.

cards.back: A flat pattern that folds up to make a 3D shape. The net of a cube is 6 squares.
cards.say: What is a net? A flat pattern that folds up to make a three D shape. The net of a cube is six squares.

cards.front: How many faces does a net of a triangular prism have?
cards.back: 5: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles.
cards.say: How many faces does a net of a triangular prism have? five: two triangles and three rectangles.

cards.back: A 3D shape with the same cross-section all the way along. Example: a triangular prism.
cards.say: What is a prism? A three D shape with the same cross section all the way along. Example: a triangular prism.

cards.front: What is a line of symmetry?
cards.back: A line that splits a shape into two halves that are mirror images.
cards.say: What is a line of symmetry? A line that splits a shape into two halves that are mirror images.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
cards.back: 6. Three go through opposite corners and three go through the middles of opposite sides.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have? six. Three go through opposite corners and three go through the middles of opposite sides.

cards.front: Order of rotational symmetry of a square
cards.back: 4. It looks the same in 4 positions in one full turn.
cards.say: Order of rotational symmetry of a square. four. It looks the same in four positions in one full turn.
